details:
sol-wallet-adapter takes the unscoped name of @project-serum/sol-wallet-adapter and has no functional code. Its preinstall script runs `node preinstall.js` on npm install, which POSTs the machine's hostname, the OS username and the local time to the Discord webhook `https://canary.discord.com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/pM5rDIrCRrEpQRbA7ibaiQk1XOQlIftmBacA5s8jD8NvXn5W-rS832DOWHQS-G-j3N6U` as "PC Notifier". Versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 were published on 2026-11-01 by the npm account cutekitten05; after they were removed, the account bigdevin55 re-created the name and published 1.0.7 with the same script on 2026-11-02, alongside contracts-upgradeable.

## Source: amazon-inspector (9663e2263b8a582279d8e96359881186bcaae3b2239c1f06e8ecddc04934ae7f)
On every `npm install`, the package's `preinstall` lifecycle script (preinstall.js) reads `os.hostname()` and `os.userInfo().username` and POSTs them, with a timestamp, to a hardcoded Discord webhook at https://canary.discord.com/api/webhooks/1566232728179843243/.... The exfiltration fires automatically before any user action and is directed to an attacker-controlled channel. The published name `sol-wallet-adapter` resembles the Solana wallet-adapter ecosystem, but the package internally identifies as `cutekitten-test` and ships only a trivial stub index.js; the install-time beacon is the sole functional code.

## Source: ghsa-malware (f038ffd59e28e32f91843379d3e8a4a4ff0e934bf02b8903a3b2b836162fce15)
Any computer that has this package installed or running should be considered fully compromised. All secrets and keys stored on that computer should be rotated immediately from a different computer. The package should be removed, but as full control of the computer may have been given to an outside entity, there is no guarantee that removing the package will remove all malicious software resulting from installing it.

## Source: ossf-package-analysis (07cf0cd27f95e20e7fe52b859d73556e78f15ca06afdcab19eb43a2616895dab)
The OpenSSF Package Analysis project identified 'sol-wallet-adapter' @ 1.0.7 (npm) as malicious.

It is considered malicious because:

- The package communicates with a domain associated with malicious activity.
